The NBS release of 31 Oct 2026 puts October's manufacturing PMI at 49.3%, below 50.0.

Poland Insight (30 Oct, updated 31 Oct) states that 'no candidate or selection deadline has been announced'; Imen Economics (30 Oct) quotes Pierrakakis only as saying the Eurogroup 'will act swiftly', and the Spanish and Dutch backing for Hernández de Cos and Knot dates from before the window (Dutch backing reported 6 Aug, per Central Banking and Accountantweek).

Al Jazeera (31 Oct): Araghchi called the Vance letter a 'positive step' but said 'We see no need to meet with the Americans at this stage'; no date was announced and Rubio said he knew of no timeframe.

No qualifying announcement found: National Theatre drama unions declared only strike readiness on 27 Oct (ČTK, before the window); dossiers read to 1 Nov 18:10Z, the ČT24 summary of 1 Nov and a web search show no National Theatre, Czech Philharmonic or ČMKOS strike entry. The listed cmkos.cz and institution sites were not checked; rests on absence of reports.
No meeting reported: the Jerusalem Post piece on Herzog's coming consultations and the Times of Israel liveblog of 31 Oct mention no Netanyahu–Eisenkot meeting; rests on absence of reports.

franceinfo headline: Interior Ministry 320,000 nationwide for 31 Oct (intersyndicale near 500,000), down from 410,000 on 24 Oct; encause.fr gives the same figure with 70,000 in Paris. The franceinfo page itself refused fetching, so this rests on its headline plus the second outlet.

Rubio: no formal meeting, 'We did not have a meeting with Lavrov; we spoke' (as quoted by CiberCuba; RFE/RL says the same). Lavrov called it a 'short conversation' and Zakharova 'contacts on foot' at the Friday reception, so neither side described a meeting or talks. Read 'razgovor' (conversation) as not 'talks'.

No official Student List PM candidate found in sources read to 31 Oct 18:15Z (dossier rs-student-pm-1), and the planning file of 1 Nov records no nomination; rests on absence of reports for the last hours of the window.

ČTK/AFP headline of 1 Nov 22:35: the truce near Oleshky ended and Russia refused to extend it, so no extension was announced on 30–31 Oct; the article body could not be opened, the ČTK listing gives the headline.
usoud.cz news read 31 Oct 17:45Z shows nothing on this case and the Court's week-45 schedule lists no plenary item (dossier cz-court-missions-1); no report of a decision found; 31 Oct was a Saturday.

Gateway Pundit and WLT Report (both 30 Oct) report that the Ninth Circuit panel (Bennett, Sanchez; Bumatay dissenting) ruled 2-1 on Friday 30 Oct against the DOJ's appeal after Carter's 28 Oct denial. The docket and the listed outlets could not be read; two independent outlets, both partisan, and the order type is inferred as denial of emergency relief.

No filing dated 30–31 Oct found: known cassação requests date from before the run-off (23 Oct and earlier), Flávio had left Brazil by 28 Oct, and a web search on 2 Nov shows nothing new; the PJe docket was not checked, so this rests on absence of reports.

Puente said on 30 Oct he would stay and remained due before the Diputación Permanente on 3 Nov (dossier es-puente-out-2, read 31 Oct; planning of 1 Nov); no Adif president departure reported; rests partly on absence of reports.

ČTK of 1 Nov (per dossier cz-dukovany-2): KHNP 'will consider its next steps' and Korea's minister criticised it; KHNP told ČT on 30 Oct it wants a new contractor; no resumption or suspension reported.
ČTK, 31 Oct: the main Czech Joy prize was shared by Zářit (Martin Páv) and Land of Fire (Nikola Klinger), neither among the 14 listed films; dokweb refers to Klinger as 'he'.
